hooks.command: root=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"); [ -f "$root/.claude/hooks/stop-gate.js" ] || exit 0; CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$root" exec node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/superhook.js" Stop -- node "$root/.claude/hooks/stop-gate.js"

root=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"); [ -f "$root/.claude/hooks/pretooluse-bash-guard.js" ] || exit 0; CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$root" exec node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/superhook.js" PreToolUse -- node "$root/.claude/hooks/pretooluse-bash-guard.js"

root=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || printf '%s' "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"); [ -f "$root/.claude/hooks/superhook.log" ] || exit 0; CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$root" exec node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/superhook-digest.js"
